notes: Every ticket requirement and security rule, mapped to the tests that check it. `tests` entries are {file, match}: `match` must appear in that test file (a test title or a guard-table row). Checked by requirements.mjs, which also links each requirement to the mutants (mutation/mutants.mjs) that break it.

CLAUDE.md explains the factory and progressive disclosure
CLAUDE.md stays under 100 lines
One folder per project, each in the index with a README

tests.match: every project folder is in the index
every project folder has a README
